Name: Babaji
Action: He encourages Yoga as a spiritual enlightenment tool, he helps with spiritual growth, yoga, breathwork and simplifying life.

Name: Buddha
Action: He encourages time alone, reflection and meditation, he helps with moderation in all things, balance, inner peace and joy.

Name: El Morya
Action: He encourages you to shield, clear and protect your vibrational energy, he helps with grounding, faith and keeping your thoughts positive.

Name: Ganesh
Action: He opens doors, clears obstacles and makes pathways for you, he will assist you to make smooth and steady progress.

Name: Isis
Action: She encourages you to be patient and kind to yourself, she assists with strength, confidence and self-esteem.

Name: Jesus
Action: He encourages you to open your heart to love and healing, he can assist you with giving and receiving love.

Name: King Solomon
Action: He encourages you to take on new projects, he will assist you to define your goals and priorities.

Name: Krishna
Action: He is a messenger of joy, happiness and romantic love, he reminds you to recognise, learn and grow from blessings and to be grateful.

Name: Kuthumi
Action: He encourages you to not get distracted and prioritise your intentions and desires, he will assist you with dedication and focus on your life purpose.

Name: Kuan Yin
Action: She encourages you to surrender and open up to your spiritual gifts, she will assist you with forgiveness and compassion of self.

Name: Lakshmi
Action: She represents prosperity, abundance, purity and generosity, she helps with overcoming financial fears.

Name: Maitreya
Action: He encourages you to stay positive and manifest your desires with joy, he assists with love, laughter, joy and happiness.

Name: Melchizedek
Action: He encourages you to work with universal energy and the Law of Attraction, he assists with positive thoughts, visualization and affirmation to create your desires.

Name: Merlin
Action: He encourages dedication and a strong work ethic, he assists lightworkers with energy healing and psychic abilities.

Name: Paravati
Action: She encourages positive changes and will assist with solutions, priorities and achieving goals.

Name: Paul the Venetian
Action: He encourages expression of your true feelings. He assists with creative and artistic expression of energy.

Name: Serapis Bey
Action: He helps you move toward ascension and spiritual enlightenment; he will motivate you to improve all areas of your life.

Name: Thoth
Action: He encourages you to write and journal, he will assist you with psychic insight and manifestation.

Name: White Buffalo Calf Woman
Action: She encourages unity, harmony and peace, she will assist with compassionate resolutions.
